question: byu-vcl PR #318, 2026-11-04: are there Kardex bay (opening) heights close to 1000 mm, and what would a taller opening allow (the MX-Lab?)
heights_note: 727.5 mm is Kardex's order sheet. 856 mm is an estimate: a 996 mm opening (one used XP 500) over the same 833 mm table, if its header stands where it does on the order sheet's unit (vlm.py's header, from Kardex's renders, 867 mm over the table for 727.5 mm of goods). 970 mm is a Euro mesh box, which the Shuttle 1000 stores on special trays: so those trays pass about 1 m. 1000 mm is the height checked.
found: Kardex's order sheets (POF) for the XP 500 give 727.5 mm (2450 x 864) and 727 mm (3050 x 864) of product height, plus 20 mm clear, 'depends on tray type selection'.
No Kardex brochure, factsheet, product page or blog found gives a taller opening for any Shuttle; Kardex's blog says 'just over 28 inches'.
The Shuttle 1000 stores Euro pallets and mesh boxes on special trays, loaded by forklift. A Euro mesh box is 970 mm tall outside. Inference: the Shuttle 1000's pallet configuration passes about 1 m.
One used XP 500 (2005/2006, 3050 x 864) is listed with a 996 mm opening over an 833 mm access table.
ac-dev-lab has no opening height; its XP-500 quote (#372) says the 32.8 in floor-to-tray height is standard but can be changed before ordering.
The Kardex TowerMat (heavy, oversized goods and pallets, 3-5 t carriers) publishes no goods height.

ask_kardex: The tallest product height through the opening on the Shuttle 700 and 1000, standard and as a special, and on the XP 500 (the used unit's 996 mm opening).

Whether a tall opening changes the tray delivery height (833 mm) or the unit height.

xp.what: Kardex Remstar Shuttle XP brochure: XP 250/500 trays 1,250-4,050 x 610-1,270 mm, up to 560 kg, 25 mm pitch; XP 700 up to 725 kg, 50 mm pitch; XP 1000 trays 610-1,778 mm deep, 1,000 kg at 1,250 mm wide, 900 kg at 2,450 mm, 800 kg at 4,050 mm; options 'Special trays for pallet storage', 'Tray extraction for forklift operation'. heavy.what: kardex.com, heavy-duty units: 'Use a forklift to stack and store EURO pallets and mesh boxes on special trays'; Shuttle 1000 'up to 825 kg per tray'

modula_cat.what: Modula Lift catalogue (US, Sept 2025), PDF p. 5: 'Modula Lift is offered in 3 sizes of bays (S/M/XL) ... Maximum product height for single delivery level 27.36 / 35.24 / 50.98 in (695 / 895 / 1,295 mm)'; dual delivery 320-320 / 320-520 / 320-920 mm. PDF p. 8, models: MC50D tray 2,500 x 857 mm, walls 70-120 mm, 1,102 lb / 500 kg; MC75D 2,500 x 857 mm, 1,653 lb / 750 kg; MC1000D 2,460 x 857 mm, walls 120 mm, 2,200 lb / 990 kg ('Maximum Tray Load Capacity'). No clearance above the goods is stated, and the tray size isn't said to be inside or outside the walls

modula_quote.what: The Apr 2 Modula quote, as Sterling's review gives it (PR #318, 2026-11-04 18:41): priced with Lift Bay S. The quote itself is not in this repo
